scope: POST-MISSION FIX AUDIT: GAP-AUTO-DONE — patrol.rs missing auto-done branch for workers that complete 100% todos but exit without calling worker-mark-done.sh. Fix adds AUTO_DONE_IDLE_SECS=120 threshold + DoneSignal::done_clean write + full downstream actions (inbox, oracle state, scope release, stall forget).

prior_audit.gap: GAP-AUTO-DONE MEDIUM at patrol.rs:193 — no auto-done branch for completed workers

user_need_match.quote: auto-done: worker idle + 100% todos, claude exited without invoking worker-mark-done.sh
user_need_match.evidence: patrol.rs:220-283 adds the missing branch. Condition: !has_done && todos_total > 0 && todos_completed >= todos_total && !already_in_done_workers && idle_secs > 120. On match: DoneSignal::new(DoneClean) written atomically (tmp→rename), ScopeClaim released, stall_detector forgotten, oracle inbox notified with worker_done event, OracleState updated with DoneClean. The exact scenario in the user-need quote (100% todos + worker exited + no done signal) now results in auto-done within 2 patrol ticks (~2 minutes).
edge_cases_covered: todos_total == 0 guard: branch only fires when todos_total > 0 (workers without progress never trigger auto-done)
Double-processing guard: !report.done_workers.contains(&session.name) prevents duplicate writes in the same patrol tick
Atomic write: DoneSignal::write() uses tmp→rename (same pattern as existing write methods in done.rs:46-51)
Downstream actions inline: inbox push + oracle state update happen in the same patrol tick, avoiding 1-tick delay
Consistent with existing done-signal handling: same scope-release + stall-forget pattern as lines 105-107

hinge_findings.concern: If todos_total is 0 (worker never updated progress), the condition would never fire — but that's correct behavior. If the worker updates todos_total=0 intentionally (no todos), we'd never auto-close it from this path.
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: todos_total > 0 guard on line 225 explicitly prevents this. Workers with no progress file or todos_total=0 are handled by the orphan detection path (lines 224-248 in the original file). No false positive possible.

hinge_findings.concern: The stall detection fires for todos_completed < todos_total. The auto-done fires for >=. These are mutually exclusive — no worker can satisfy both simultaneously.
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: Mathematical: todos_completed cannot be both < todos_total and >= todos_total. Verified by grep: line 194 uses <, line 226 uses >=. No overlap possible.

hinge_findings.concern: If two patrol ticks fire simultaneously (e.g. race on slow filesystem), both could see !has_done and attempt to write.
hinge_findings.verified_safe_by: DoneSignal::write uses atomic tmp→rename (done.rs:47-51). The second write is a no-op at the filesystem level (overwrite with same content). The !report.done_workers.contains check prevents double-processing within the same tick. Across ticks, the first successful write makes DoneSignal::read return Some on the next tick, skipping the block entirely.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: File-based stall loop only handled todos_completed < todos_total. No branch for the completed-but-no-done-signal case. Workers that finish all todos but exit without calling worker-mark-done.sh were never closed.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix_applied: Added AUTO_DONE_IDLE_SECS=120 constant and new branch at patrol.rs:220-283. Writes DoneSignal::done_clean with progress counts, releases scope, forgets from stall detector, notifies oracle inbox, updates oracle state — all matching the existing done-signal handling pattern.
